normative_extracts.spec_section: 3. Using Cascading Variables: the var() notation
normative_extracts.quote: If a property contains one or more var() functions, and those functions are syntactically valid, the entire property’s grammar must be assumed to be valid at parse time.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Engine stores --var as raw tokens; var() substitutes at computed-value time and falls back to initial/inherited (IACVT) if invalid.

production_failures.symptom: Property using var(--bad-token) ignores the previous fallback declaration and resets to transparent
production_failures.root_cause: Invalid At Computed Value Time (IACVT): parse-time fallback rules were already discarded before var() substituted.
production_failures.mitigation: Provide a fallback inside var(--token, #2563eb) rather than a separate fallback line above it.

production_failures.symptom: Mutating --scroll-y on :root triggers a 15ms style recalculation across 3,000 nodes
production_failures.root_cause: Custom properties inherit by default, so changing a :root variable invalidates ComputedStyle on the entire document.
production_failures.mitigation: Scope frequently mutated variables to the smallest subtree or register them with @property { inherits: false }.
